title: Mobile, touch and the attached gamepad (GameSir X2s Type-C)
findings: BOOT CONFIRMED before work: node tools/harness/smoke.mjs passes 6/6 (chromium 141, SwiftShader).

tools/journey/gamepad-shim.mjs EXISTS and is real (14.4 KB) — injects at the navigator.getGamepads() seam with x2s-standard / x2s-hid-dualsense / xbox-standard presets, dispatches real GamepadEvents, has --self-test. NOT phantom. tools/journey/journey-run.mjs IS phantom — mine to write.

DEFECT (desktop, hard): game/src/input/bindings.js binds spell_cycle:['KeyR'] and heavy:['KeyR','Mouse3']. buildControlMap() iterates in key order so spell_cycle OVERWRITES heavy on KeyR — the heavy attack is unreachable on its normative primary key. RI-JRN03 M-K1 hard fail.
DEFECT (pad, HF1): GAMEPAD_BINDINGS does not bind sprint, swap_left or swap_right at all. RI-JRN04 G1/M-P1 hard fail (any of the fourteen unbound).

DEFECT (pad): block=6(LT) and parry=4(LB) are SWAPPED vs RI-JRN04 §C (block must be LB=4 held, parry LT=6). jump on 3(Y) not 10(L3); two_hand on 8(Back) which §C reserves for journal; lock_on on 10(L3) not 11(R3).
DEFECT (pad, HF8): triggers read `b.pressed || b.value > 0.5` — no T_fire 0.35 / T_release 0.20 hysteresis, no T_full 0.85 charge gate. RI-JRN04 G0 says reading .pressed on a trigger is a defect.
DEFECT (pad, HF-most-load-bearing): no roll/sprint 12-frame tap/hold discriminator on button 1. roll is a plain discrete; sprint has no pad control at all.

DEFECT (pad, HF2): no mapping!=='standard' path. pushGamepadState() hard-codes mapping:'standard' and boolean-only buttons, so it cannot even express the X2s' DualSense-like HID mode. No pad-quirks.json, no calibration sequence.
DEFECT (pad lifecycle): no gamepadconnected/gamepaddisconnected listeners anywhere. Disconnect is only noticed at the next poll; L6 (two pads) takes the first connected, not the most recently active.

ABSENT ENTIRELY: touch input (RI-JRN04 §G, 14 actions, T1-T10) — zero touch code in the tree. Rebinding model (RI-JRN03 §E RB1-RB11) — zero. Mobile viewport/orientation/safe-area (§F H1-H12) — game/index.html uses 100vh (H4 bans it, `RI-JRN04` How-we-lose #8) and has no env(safe-area-inset-*) use.
HARNESS GAPS: A-JRN4 (viewport/orientation/safe-area control) and A-JRN12 (keyboard-layout emulation) are declared absent by api.js's own capability report. M-P16..M-P19 and M-K2 need them.

CORPUS CONFLICT: RI-JRN04 §D sets the right-stick inner deadzone at 0.10 and curve m'^2.0; the shipped shapeLookStick() implements RI-CAM02 §A's 0.15/0.95/quadratic. RI-JRN04's own header cedes camera behaviour to RI-CAM02 but claims the stick transform (deadzone, curve, sensitivity). Recorded as corpus debt; see report.

tools/journey/journey-run.mjs LANDED at 07:09 from the tool builder (50 KB) with --journey jrn03-desktop/jrn04-pad, --layouts, --gamepad, --dpr, --pointer, --self-test, and it reads harness_amendments_absent from getCapabilityReport(). I did NOT write it.

A-JRN4 was absent; I implemented it (game/src/input/viewport.js + __HARNESS.setViewport/getViewport) and updated api.js's capability report. A-JRN2 already worked via __HARNESS.gamepad(); I widened pushGamepadState() to carry a real `mapping` string and per-button `.value` so a non-standard descriptor can reach the translation layer.
Another agent's in-flight commit (9d2d981) absorbed my files; I did not commit.

MEASURED ON THE REPO TREE: 41/41 checks pass (desktop 16, pad 16, touch 5, viewport 4, rebind 4); --self-test 5/5 instruments went red under a perturbation of their own model. journey-run jrn03-desktop and jrn04-pad both complete; m_layouts qwerty/azerty/qwertz all moved, 0 dropped.
LATENCY: keyboard p50 1 frame / p100 1 frame over 200 inputs (M-K23); pad p50 1 / p100 1 over 200 presses (M-P10). Threshold was p100 <= 2.

DEFECTS I FOUND AND FIXED IN MY OWN WORK, via the probe: (a) the tap/hold discriminator was off by one — 12 frames held came out as a roll, because the quantity is frames HELD (delta+1), not the raw delta; (b) GamepadRouter.setProfile() moved the router default but left every already-connected pad on the old map, so souls-handheld did nothing on a phone; (c) `!chosen` is falsy for pad index 0, so with two pads the first could never stay active and _releasePad dropped what it held; (d) a pad whose IDENTITY changed at the same index kept the previous pad's quirk map; (e) TouchInput read performance.now() inside the fixed step (determinism guard killed the run) and its frame-numbered timer stranded when sim.frame rewound.

CORPUS FINDING: `droppedInputs` counts three different things — inputs the pipeline LOST, presses outside the 8f buffer window (RI-CMB09 §1 mandates dropping those), and presses the combat model refused (4 sites in combat/player.js + sim/player.js). RI-JRN03 M-K24 asks for 0 over 10,000 inputs, which read 9,487 on a build that had lost nothing. Split into pipelineDrops (0) and bufferMisses without changing droppedInputs' existing meaning. M-K24 and RI-CMB09 §1 contradict each other as written.

PROBE TRAP, binding on any future input probe: engine._censusStep calls input.consumeUI(CENSUS_ACTIONS) = interact/block/light/heavy/roll AND consumeUI zeroes moveX/moveY. At the boot state (barge hold) a working radial deadzone measures [0,0] at every magnitude and 5 of 16 actions read as dead buttons. Read pipe.edges (pushed in latchForStep BEFORE any surface consumes), which is what RI-JRN03 M-K1 means by 'from the trace'. Also: pressing `interact` in an arena opens a conversation that consumes movement until `block` closes it.

SHARED TREE: tools/journey/journey-run.mjs landed from the tool builder at 07:09 and needed three declared fixes to run at all — --entry/--url passthrough, waiting for ready() after the shim reload (every --gamepad run aborted at exit 12), and its `import { installShim }` became a SyntaxError when a later shim round removed that export, taking all nine journeys down.

NOT CLOSED: four authored strings (two rebinding refusals, the rotate line, six calibration prompts) and the whole touch overlay are computed and exposed but NOT DRAWN — RI-JRN03 CONSUMPTION §4's 'orphan text'. game/src/render/ui.js is where they must land. Also M-K21/M-K22 (inscription census, prompt purity) need RI-JRN01 O12's inscription entities; the naive passes are isolation-enforced and belong to a fresh agent; H8 thermal is Tier-H.
next_step: critic: re-run `node tools/journey/input-checks.mjs --group <g>` per group (they share one page and must not be combined), plus --self-test; then the isolation-enforced naive passes JC-03N and JC-04N.
notes_for_successor: The report is reports/W1-08-W1-29-INPUT.md. Do NOT combine --group values in one run: the groups share one page and the touch sweep's `interact` presses open a conversation that consumes movement for everything after it. The one thing left to build is the DRAWING: the touch overlay and four authored strings exist and are measured through their models but no renderer draws them (game/src/render/ui.js). Two corpus conflicts need arbitration: RI-JRN04 §D vs RI-CAM02 §A on the stick deadzones, and RI-JRN03 M-K24 vs RI-CMB09 §1 on what `droppedInputs` may count. Both are argued in §6 and §5 of the report.
